$comment: Wrapper counterpart of rev-005 (#176 item 13). rev-005 puts an unknown member in the signed inner `revocation_list` body (UNKNOWN_FIELD); this fixture puts one, `fetched_at`, in the unsigned transport wrapper beside `revocation_list` and `signature`. The inner body is rev-003's fresh, non-revoked shape, so the wrapper member is the only defect under test.
description: Revocation snapshot whose transport wrapper carries a third member, `fetched_at`, beside `revocation_list` and `signature`. RFC-AITP-0008 §1.5 requires the wrapper to contain exactly those two members. The wrapper is unsigned and has no extension namespace, so the RFC-AITP-0001 §7 rule for a signed object's members does not apply to it. Receivers MUST reject with REVOCATION_SNAPSHOT_INVALID, not UNKNOWN_FIELD.

expected.rationale: The wrapper MUST contain exactly `revocation_list` and `signature` (RFC-AITP-0008 §1.5; registry REVOCATION_SNAPSHOT_INVALID row). The signed inner body is unchanged from rev-003 and valid.
